literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the ninth month, Grand White again encroached upon the Right Upholder of the Law.
idiomatic: That ninth month, Venus again crossed the star called Right Law Enforcement.

literal: Investigating the prognostication texts: "When the Five Stars' calamities coincide, metal and fire are especially severe."
idiomatic: The manuals say that when several of the Five Planets jointly portend disaster, Venus and Mars weigh heaviest.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the eleventh month, day Wuzi, Grand White encroached upon the upper star of Fang (the Room).
idiomatic: On the Wuzi day in the eleventh month, Venus trespassed the upper star of the Room asterism.

literal: The divination states: "The senior minister will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: The omen read: the chief minister faces peril.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the fifth year, fourth month, day Yiwei, the moon encroached upon the separation star of Bi (the Net).
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on Yiwei in the fourth month, the Moon occulted the Net's gap star.

literal: The divination states: "Armies will arise."
idiomatic: The gloss warned that war would break out.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the seventh month, day Jiyou, the moon encroached upon the upper star of Fang.
idiomatic: On Jiyou in the seventh month, the Moon crossed the upper star of the Room.

literal: The divination states: "Generals and ministers will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: The omen read: generals and ministers were imperiled.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In that month, day Gengshen, Chancellor Wang Dao died; Yu Bing replaced him in assisting governance.
idiomatic: That same month, on Gengshen, Chancellor Wang Dao died, and Yu Bing took his place at the helm of government.

literal: In the eighth month, Grand Commandant Xi Jian died.
idiomatic: In the eighth month Grand Commandant Xi Jian passed away.

literal: Moreover there was the defeat at Zhucheng south of the Mian, and more than ten thousand households of common people drifted in exile.
idiomatic: There was also the rout at Zhucheng south of the Han, sending over ten thousand households into flight.

literal: In the sixth year, first month, General Who Conquers the West Yu Liang died.
idiomatic: In the sixth year's first month the western commander-in-chief Yu Liang died.

literal: In the sixth year, third month, day Jiachen, Sparking Deluder encroached upon the outer general star of Supreme Subtlety.
idiomatic: On Jiachen in the third month of the sixth year, Mars trespassed the outer general star of Supreme Subtlety.

literal: The divination states: "The senior general will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: The omen read: the senior field commander faced danger.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the fourth month, day Dingchou, Sparking Deluder encroached upon the Right Upholder of the Law.
idiomatic: On Dingchou in the fourth month, Mars transgressed Right Law Enforcement.

literal: The divination states: "Those who hold power will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: The omen read: the ruling ministers were at risk.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the sixth month, day Yihai, the moon encroached upon the central star of Qianniu (the Ox).
idiomatic: On Yihai in the sixth month, the Moon trespassed the central star of the Ox.

literal: The divination states: "The great general will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: The omen read: the commander-in-chief faced misfortune.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] At that time, He Chong, Director of the Secretariat (the text writes "present" for the office title), was Upholder of the Law; there was blame; wishing to avoid its fault, the next year he sought to become Director of the Palace Secretariat.
idiomatic: At the time He Chong headed the Secretariat and held the law portfolio; censured, he maneuvered the next year into the Palace Secretariat to escape blame.

literal: That fourth month, day Bingwu, Grand White encroached upon the separation star of Bi.
idiomatic: That fourth month, on Bingwu, Venus occulted the Net's gap star.

literal: The divination states: "Weapons and leather will arise."
idiomatic: The omen read: war would erupt.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] One version states: "The female ruler will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: Another gloss adds: the empress was imperiled.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the sixth month, day Yimao, Grand White encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan (the Chariot Shaft).
idiomatic: On Yimao in the sixth month, Venus trespassed the principal star of the Chariot Shaft.

literal: The divination states: "The female ruler will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: The omen read: the palace mistress faced disaster.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the seventh year, third month, Empress Du died.
idiomatic: In the seventh year's third month Empress Du passed away.

literal: In the seventh year, third month, day Renwu, the moon encroached upon Fang.
idiomatic: On Renwu in the third month of the seventh year, the Moon crossed the Room.

literal: Fourth month, day Jichou, Grand White entered Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: On Jichou in the fourth month, Venus entered the Ghost asterism.

literal: In the fifth month, Grand White was seen in the daytime.
idiomatic: In the fifth month Venus appeared by daylight.

literal: Eighth month, day Xinchou, the moon encroached upon Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: On Xinchou in the eighth month, the Moon trespassed the Ghost asterism.

literal: In the eighth year, sixth month, Sparking Deluder encroached upon the second upper star of Fang.
idiomatic: In the eighth year's sixth month, Mars crossed the second star above in the Room.

literal: The divination states: "The secondary minister will suffer trouble."
idiomatic: The omen read: the deputy chief minister was at risk.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Eighth month, day Renyin, the moon encroached upon Bi.
idiomatic: On Renyin in the eighth month, the Moon crossed the Net.

literal: The divination states: "The lower will offend the higher; weapons and leather will arise."
idiomatic: The gloss warned of subjects rising against superiors and war breaking out.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the tenth month, the moon again covered the great star of Bi.
idiomatic: In the tenth month the Moon again occulted the Net's chief star.

literal: The divination is the same as above.
idiomatic: The interpretation matched the foregoing entries.

literal: In the second year of Jianyuan, General of Chariots and Cavalry Yu Bing died.
idiomatic: In Jianyuan 2 the chariot-and-cavalry general Yu Bing died.

literal: Yu Yi greatly raised troops, plotting to attack Shi Hu, monopolizing the upper reaches; the court feared him.
idiomatic: Yu Yi mobilized a large force to campaign against Shi Hu, dominating the middle Yangzi, and the court was wary of him.

literal: In the first year of Kangdi's Jianyuan, first month, day Renwu, Grand White entered Mao (the Pleiades).
idiomatic: Jianyuan 1 of Emperor Kang, first month, Renwu: Venus entered the Hairy Head asterism.

literal: The divination states: "There will be troops in the Zhao region."
idiomatic: The omen read: warfare in the Zhao heartland.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] It also states: "Under Heaven armies will arise."
idiomatic: It added that war would flare across the realm.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Fourth month, day Yiyou, Grand White was seen in the daytime.
idiomatic: On Yiyou in the fourth month, Venus shone in daylight.

literal: That year, Shi Hu killed his son Shi Sui, also sent generals to raid and capture Didao, and encamped east of Ji, plotting against Murong Huang.
idiomatic: That year Shi Hu executed his heir Shi Sui, sent columns to seize Didao, massed east of Ji, and schemed against Murong Huang.

literal: In the second year, the Year Star encroached upon Heaven's Gate.
idiomatic: In the second year Jupiter crossed the Celestial Gate asterism.

literal: General Who Pacifies the West Yu Yi wrote to his elder brother Yu Bing: "The Year Star encroached upon Heaven's Gate; the prognostication says passes and bridges should split."
idiomatic: Western pacification general Yu Yi wrote Yu Bing that Jupiter at Heaven's Gate foretold severed passes and river crossings.

literal: "Lately east of the river there has been no other reason, and the river route is not difficult, yet Shi Hu year after year twice closes the passes, not communicating envoys; this again is Heaven being muddled, without a sign of black and white."
idiomatic: He noted no new trouble in Wu and an open waterway, yet Shi Hu repeatedly sealed the passes and cut envoys—Heaven itself seemed confused, giving no clear verdict.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In that intercalary month, day Yiyou, Grand White encroached upon the Dipper.
idiomatic: That intercalary month, on Yiyou, Venus crossed the Dipper.

literal: The divination states: "There will be mourning; Under Heaven will receive noble ranks and stipends."
idiomatic: The gloss foretold a death and empire-wide ennoblements.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the ninth month, the emperor died; the heir-apparent was established; a great amnesty was proclaimed; noble ranks were bestowed.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor died, the crown prince acceded, a general pardon was issued, and titles were granted.

literal: In the first year of Emperor Mu's Yonghe, first month, day Dingchou, the moon entered Bi.
idiomatic: Yonghe 1 of Emperor Mu, Dingchou in the first month: the Moon entered the Net.

literal: The divination states: "Armies will arise on a great scale."
idiomatic: The omen read: major mobilization.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Wuyin, the moon encroached upon Heaven's Gate.
idiomatic: On Wuyin the Moon crossed the Celestial Gate.

literal: The divination states: "There will be rebellious ministers altering the Son of Heaven's laws."
idiomatic: It warned of traitorous ministers overturning the sovereign's statutes.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Fifth month, day Xinsi, Grand White was seen in the daytime, in Eastern Well.
idiomatic: On Xinsi in the fifth month, Venus appeared by day in the Well.

literal: The divination states: "Ministers will be strong; Qin will have troops."
idiomatic: The gloss read powerful ministers and Qin-sector warfare.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Sixth month, day Xinchou, the moon entered Supreme Subtlety, encroaching upon the screen's southwest star.
idiomatic: On Xinchou in the sixth month, the Moon entered Supreme Subtlety and crossed the southwest screen star.

literal: The divination states: "Supporting ministers will suffer dismissal."
idiomatic: It foretold senior aides removed from office.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] In the seventh month and eighth month, the moon both encroached upon Bi.
idiomatic: In the seventh and eighth months the Moon twice crossed the Net.

literal: The divination is the same as above.
idiomatic: The reading matched the earlier gloss.

literal: Jiwei, the moon encroached upon Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: On Jiwei the Moon trespassed the Ghost asterism.

literal: The divination states: "Great ministers will be executed."
idiomatic: The omen read: high ministers would be put to death.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Ninth month, day Gengxu, the moon again encroached upon Bi.
idiomatic: On Gengxu in the ninth month the Moon again crossed the Net.

literal: At the beginning of this year, Yu Yi was at Xiangyang.
idiomatic: Early that year Yu Yi was stationed at Xiangyang.

literal: In the seventh month, as Yi's illness was about to end, he thereupon made his son Yuanzhi Jingzhou inspector, replacing himself in the post.
idiomatic: In the seventh month, as Yu Yi neared death, he tried to install his son Yuanzhi as Jingzhou governor in his place.

literal: Yuanzhi was shortly thereafter deposed.
idiomatic: Yuanzhi was soon cashiered.

literal: The next year, Huan Wen again thereupon led the host to attack Shu, seized Li Shi, and sent him to the capital.
idiomatic: The following year Huan Wen again marched on Shu, captured Li Shi, and sent him to the capital.

literal: Shu was originally Qin territory.
idiomatic: Shu had been heartland of Qin.

literal: Second year, second month, day Renzi, the moon encroached upon the upper star of Fang.
idiomatic: On Renzi in the second month of the second year, the Moon crossed the Room's upper star.

literal: Fourth month, day Bing-Rong (the stem-branch as written), the moon again encroached upon the upper star of Fang.
idiomatic: On Bingxu in the fourth month (the text writes an irregular branch), the Moon again crossed the Room's upper star.

literal: Eighth month, day Renshen, Grand White encroached upon the Left Upholder of the Law.
idiomatic: On Renshen in the eighth month, Venus transgressed Left Law Enforcement.

literal: Third year, first month, day Renwu, the moon encroached upon the fifth star of Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: Third year, Renwu in the first month: the Moon crossed the fifth Southern Dipper star.

literal: The divination states: "The general will die; intimate ministers will depart."
idiomatic: The gloss foretold a general's death and the fall of close advisers.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Fifth month, day Renshen, the moon encroached upon the fourth star of Southern Dipper, thereupon entering the ladle-bowl.
idiomatic: On Renshen in the fifth month the Moon crossed the fourth Southern Dipper star and entered the dipper bowl.

literal: The divination states: "There will be troops."
idiomatic: It indicated armed conflict.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] One version states: "There will be a great amnesty."
idiomatic: Another line read: a sweeping pardon.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Sixth month, the moon encroached upon the separation star of Eastern Well.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the Moon occulted the Well's gap star.

literal: The divination states: "The general will die; the state will have trouble."
idiomatic: It warned of a field commander's death and national mourning.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Shu-xu (the cyclical characters as written), the moon encroached upon the Five Feudatories.
idiomatic: On Wuxu (the manuscript's stem-branch is garbled), the Moon crossed the Five Feudatories.

literal: The divination states: "Feudatories will be executed."
idiomatic: The omen read: great lords would be struck down.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Ninth month, day Gengyin, Grand White encroached upon the fifth star of Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: On Gengyin in the ninth month, Venus crossed the fifth Southern Dipper star.

literal: The divination states: "There will be mourning; there will be troops."
idiomatic: It paired bereavement with war.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Fourth year, seventh month, day Bingshen, Grand White encroached upon the Left Upholder of the Law.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on Bingshen in the seventh month, Venus transgressed Left Law Enforcement.

literal: Jiayin, the moon encroached upon Fang.
idiomatic: On Jiayin the Moon crossed the Room.

literal: Dingsi, the moon entered Southern Dipper, encroaching upon the second star.
idiomatic: On Dingsi the Moon entered the Dipper and crossed its second star.

literal: Yichou, Grand White encroached upon the Left Upholder of the Law.
idiomatic: On Yichou Venus again crossed Left Law Enforcement.

literal: The divinations are all the same as above.
idiomatic: Those omens matched the preceding glosses.

literal: Tenth month, day Jiachen, the moon encroached upon Kang.
idiomatic: On Jiachen in the tenth month the Moon trespassed the Neck asterism.

literal: The divination states: "Armies will arise; the general will die."
idiomatic: It foretold mobilization and a commander's end.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Eleventh month, day Wuxu, the moon encroached upon the upper general star.
idiomatic: On Wuxu in the eleventh month the Moon crossed the senior general star.

literal: In the sixth month of the third year, a great amnesty.
idiomatic: The third year's sixth month brought a general pardon.

literal: That month, Chen Kui campaigned against Shou-chun, was defeated, and returned.
idiomatic: That month Chen Kui attacked Shouchun, was beaten, and withdrew.

literal: Seventh month, remnant bandits of the Di and Shu rebelled, throwing Yi territory into chaos.
idiomatic: In the seventh month Di and Shu holdouts revolted and ravaged the west.

literal: Ninth month, Shi Hu campaigned against Liangzhou.
idiomatic: In the ninth month Shi Hu invaded Liangzhou.

literal: In the fifth year, General Who Conquers the North Chu Pou died.
idiomatic: In the fifth year northern expedition commander-in-chief Chu Pou died.

literal: Fourth year, fourth month, Grand White entered Mao; at that time Rong and Jin attacked each other, and in the Zhao region warfare linked especially thickly.
idiomatic: Fourth year, fourth month: Venus entered the Hairy Head while barbarians and Jin clashed, with heaviest fighting in Zhao.

literal: Seventh month, Grand White encroached upon Xuanyuan.
idiomatic: In the seventh month Venus crossed the Chariot Shaft.

literal: The divination states: "In Zhao, and there will be troops and mourning."
idiomatic: The gloss read war and funerals for the Zhao sector.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Jiayin, the moon encroached upon Fang.
idiomatic: On Jiayin the Moon again crossed the Room.

literal: Tenth month, day Jia-Wu-Xu (the cyclical characters as written), the moon encroached upon Kang.
idiomatic: In the tenth month, on Jiaxu (the text repeats the branch), the Moon trespassed the Neck.

literal: The divination states: "Armies will arise; the general will die."
idiomatic: The omen again paired war with a general's death.

literal: [Closing quotation mark] Eighth month, Shi Hu's heir-apparent Shi Xuan killed his younger brother Shi Tao; Xuan also died.
idiomatic: In the eighth month Shi Hu's crown prince Shi Xuan murdered his brother Shi Tao, then perished himself.
